title: Customer registration and KYC
statement: The system shall allow a Customer to register and complete KYC using Aadhaar and PAN identity documents, with format validation only (mocked verification).
preconditions: The Customer is not yet registered in the system.
Aadhaar and PAN document attribute values are provided by the Customer.
postconditions: The Customer is registered and a KYC Record is created in PENDING state.
Aadhaar and PAN values are validated for format only and stored.
assumptions: KYC document checks validate format only and do not call external government verification services.

title: Account onboarding and activation
statement: The system shall allow a Customer to onboard an account, and shall allow Bank operations to review and activate it before the account can be used.
preconditions: The Customer has a registration and KYC record.
The account has been onboarded by the Customer and is in PENDING state.
postconditions: The account is activated by Bank operations and available for use.
All activation state changes are recorded in the audit trail.
assumptions: Account review and activation are performed solely by the Bank operations role.

title: Role-based login
statement: The system shall allow Customer and Bank operations users to log in, with role-based access control applied.
preconditions: The user is registered and has a valid identity.
The user is not currently authenticated with an active session.
postconditions: An authenticated Session is created for the user.
The user is granted access only to the resources permitted by their role.
assumptions: Login credentials map to the Customer or Bank operations role.

title: Logout
statement: The system shall allow Customer and Bank operations users to log out, terminating their authenticated session.
preconditions: The user is authenticated with an active Session.
postconditions: The authenticated Session is terminated and can no longer authorize actions.
assumptions: Logout is available to both Customer and Bank operations roles.

title: Synthetic money transfer
statement: The system shall allow a Customer to initiate a synthetic money transfer to another account.
preconditions: The Customer is authenticated.
The source account is active and in ACTIVE state.
The source account balance meets any applicable minimum balance requirement.
postconditions: A Transaction is created in PENDING state for the transfer.
The transfer completes only if balance and transfer-cap limits are satisfied.
All transfer state changes are recorded in the audit trail.
assumptions: Transfers are synthetic; no real payment rails or real fund movement is involved.

title: Receive synthetic money transfer
statement: The system shall allow a Customer's account to receive a synthetic money transfer.
preconditions: The receiving account is in ACTIVE state.
A valid incoming transfer is initiated by another Customer.
postconditions: The receiving account balance is credited by the transfer amount.
The Transaction reaches a SUCCESS/COMPLETED state.
assumptions: All money transfers and receipts are synthetic.

title: View account statement
statement: The system shall allow Customer and Bank operations users to view account statements according to their role permissions.
preconditions: The user is authenticated.
The account and its statement are available.
postconditions: The user views the statement content permitted by their role.
assumptions: Statement view is available to both Customer and Bank operations roles.

title: Download account statement
statement: The system shall allow a Customer to download their account statement.
preconditions: The Customer is authenticated.
A statement exists for the account.
postconditions: The Customer receives a downloadable statement artifact for their own account only.
assumptions: Statement download is available to the Customer role only in v1.

title: View audit trail
statement: The system shall allow Bank operations to view the audit trail of account and KYC state changes.
preconditions: The Bank operations user is authenticated.
At least one audit event has been recorded.
postconditions: The user views the audit trail including actor, action, and timestamp for each recorded change.
assumptions: Audit trailing is restricted to the Bank operations role.

title: Prevent Bank operations fund transfers
statement: The system shall prevent Bank operations users from initiating money transfers.
preconditions: The Bank operations user is authenticated.
postconditions: The Bank operations user is unable to initiate any money transfer through the system.
assumptions: Role-based access control denies transfer initiation to Bank operations.

title: Authentication for all actions
statement: The system shall require authentication for every Customer and Bank operations action, protecting account and identity data appropriate to a banking simulation.
preconditions: A user identity exists in the system.
postconditions: No Customer or Bank operations action is permitted without a valid authenticated Session.
assumptions: Only synthetic identity and account data is involved; no real customer PII.

title: Sensitive data access restricted by role
statement: The system shall treat KYC and account data as sensitive and restrict access to it by role.
preconditions: Sensitive KYC or account data exists in the system.
A role identity exists for the requesting user.
postconditions: Access to sensitive KYC and account data is granted only to roles permitted to view it.
assumptions: Data sensitivity is determined by role-based access control.

title: Accessibility
statement: Customer- and Bank-operations-facing interfaces shall meet accessibility requirements as an acceptance condition.
preconditions: The interfaces are implemented and available.
postconditions: Interfaces are accessible to users with disabilities as an acceptance condition.
assumptions: Accessibility conformance is verified as part of acceptance testing.

title: Reliable persistence of state changes
statement: The system shall reliably persist account, KYC, and transaction state changes without data loss.
preconditions: Account, KYC, or transaction data exists to be persisted.
postconditions: Account, KYC, and transaction state changes are durably persisted without loss.
assumptions: Persistence durability is verified through reliability testing.

title: Testability
statement: The system shall be built to be testable, including deterministic synthetic data and stable UI selectors for test automation.
preconditions: The deterministic synthetic data and UI are implemented.
postconditions: System behavior is testable with deterministic synthetic data and stable UI selectors.
assumptions: The data-testid selector convention is settled before detailed system-test design begins (OQ-004).

title: Audit trail recording
statement: All account, KYC, and transfer state changes shall be recorded with actor, action, and timestamp to support audit-trail viewing and defect root-cause analysis.
preconditions: An account, KYC, or transfer state change is about to be performed.
postconditions: Every such state change is recorded with actor, action, and timestamp.
assumptions: Audit trail entries are immutable once recorded.

title: Traceability and artifact governance
statement: Every approved business rule shall be traceable through requirement, design, implementation, test, and evidence record, and all agent-produced artifacts shall be reviewable, reproducible, schema-valid, source-linked, and subject to human approval.
preconditions: A business rule is approved for inclusion.
postconditions: The business rule is traceable across SDLC stages and its artifacts are reviewable, reproducible, schema-valid, source-linked, and human-approved.
assumptions: Human approval is required before any artifact is treated as approved.
